description: File-to-purpose mapping for instant codebase navigation. Updated after each feature.

packages/db/src/repositories/feature.ts.purpose: FeatureRepository with CRUD, query by project/status, bulk status update, dependency resolution, and transaction support

packages/db/src/repositories/session.ts.purpose: SessionRepository with CRUD, findActive, findByFeature, appendOutput (SQL CASE WHEN), calculateDuration helper, and withTransaction support

packages/db/src/repositories/index.ts.purpose: Barrel export for all repository modules

packages/db/src/index.ts.purpose: Database client initialization (libSQL/Drizzle) and barrel export for db, migrations, and repositories

apps/server/src/index.ts.purpose: Main Hono server entry with oRPC routing, CORS middleware, error handlers (app.onError, app.notFound), health check route, and Bun serve export

packages/env/src/server.ts.purpose: Server-side environment variable validation with Zod, includes DATABASE_URL format validation (file:, libsql://, http), PORT with coerce and default(3000)

apps/server/src/index.test.ts.purpose: Unit tests for Hono app handlers (createTestApp pattern to avoid top-level side effects). Tests: health check GET /, 404 not found, error handling for HTTPException and generic errors
